Poppy.build: Build armor first against the primary damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, at long range hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark her as Challenged, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard when you need to survive after engaging.
Poppy.escape: Immediately after you force Poppy to use E Heroic Charge, you have a chance to close the gap. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, hold Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge until its duration ends, then go in. In teamfights, engage after Poppy E Heroic Charge and R Keeper’s Verdict are down.
Poppy.fight: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Weave Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning between the empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike to slow her, then follow through with the third attack’s knockup. Stay out of Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s zone, and account for her armor increasing when her health is low; fight when you’re sure you have enough damage to finish her.
Poppy.laning: Take Poppy E Heroic Charge in open space, without a wall or narrow passage behind you. When the shield Poppy throws with Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it before she can retrieve it to deny her shield. When ganking, if river vision makes a direct approach difficult, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark the target as Challenged, then approach with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Poppy.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and set up for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, you’re vulnerable once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Poppy.teamfight: Engage after Poppy E Heroic Charge and R Keeper’s Verdict are down. If Poppy is on an allied damage dealer, clear space in front of them with the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard grants immunity only to champions outside your spear’s range, so don’t assume it will protect you from the damage and crowd control of a nearby Poppy.
Poppy.watch: If you engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks your dash and briefly prevents you from using movement abilities. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so stay in open space. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the zone before the second hit detonates. If you see Poppy charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her line of attack.

Amumu.teamfight: Engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. If Amumu dives your allied damage dealers, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock away enemies without a Challenge mark and clear space in front of your allies. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity does not block damage from nearby melee champions or crowd control, so don’t rely on it as you go in.
Amumu.combo: Against a distant target, hit them with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and land three empowered attacks to knock them up with the final hit. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock back enemies without a Challenge mark.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stuns you on hit, and the follow-up Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy also stuns nearby enemies. Stand behind a minion or jungle monster to dodge Q, and stay spread out from your allies while R is available.
Amumu.escape: The window to engage is after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no skill to create distance, so close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and follow through to the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Amumu.fight: After Amumu Q Bandage Toss and R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and apply brief pressure. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your maximum health while you stay nearby, so don’t fight him at close range for long.
Amumu.build: Prioritize tenacity or a way to remove crowd control to deal with Amumu Q Bandage Toss and R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Then build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage, and armor penetration to counter Amumu E Tantrum, which reduces physical damage.
Amumu.laning: When ganking from far away, mark your target with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Amumu.phase: After Amumu gets R Curse of the Sad Mummy, start a fight when it is down. In the late game, Xin Zhao is vulnerable once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.

Elise.laning: Set up vision to stop Elise’s early ganks, and don’t push the lane recklessly when she’s missing. Stand behind minions along gank paths to block Elise E Cocoon, and near the jungle, move toward the side with vision instead of hugging walls. If you confirm Elise is on the opposite side, check whether the enemy laner can rotate, then take a camp and leave.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. Also consider armor, as she deals damage with basic attacks too. Elise P Spider Queen heals her, so if you need to kill her, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Elise.combo: At long range, hit the target with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust to apply Challenge, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. To start at close range, knock them up with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike → basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack. Don’t activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard before engaging; use it after you’re close when you need to survive.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise uses Elise Q Venomous Bite to close in, look for an opportunity to close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down, counter-engage and lock her down with the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. While Elise is airborne from Elise E Rappel, save Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge until she lands.
Elise.fight: Dodge Elise E Cocoon or bait her into using it, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once you’re close, knock her up with the third empowered attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and if you’re surrounded, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to block damage from outside spear range. When Elise switches to Elise R Spider Form, watch for her finishing attack and time Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard accordingly.
Elise.phase: Early on, Elise will look to gain an advantage through ganks, so it’s important not to give up kills. In the late game, don’t engage alone because you’ll be vulnerable once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Elise.teamfight: Confirm Elise E Cocoon is down before engaging. If an enemy dives your allied damage dealers, use the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to peel them off and clear space in front of your allies. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to enemies outside spear range, so don’t engage expecting it to block damage from nearby enemies.
Elise.watch: Elise E Cocoon stuns the first unit it hits, so stand behind a minion or jungle monster to block it. When health is high, watch for Elise Q Neurotoxin; after health has decreased and Elise has switched to Elise R Spider Form, watch for Elise Q Venomous Bite. Don’t use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge while Elise is airborne from E Rappel; wait for her to land.

Nocturne.phase: In the mid game, use the window when Nocturne R Paranoia is down, and while his ultimate is ready, establish vision and decide where you and your allies can retreat. Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable right after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends in the late game, so don't engage alone.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first against Nocturne's main damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Armor can't block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades is preventing kills, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Nocturne.combo: Against a distant Nocturne, hit him with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is also down, you can go for the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike without worrying about fear. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is tethered to you, identify a minion or jungle monster in the direction you want to escape so you can create distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the spell shield first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then look for the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. When Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and fight. Damage immunity from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard can't block damage and crowd control from Nocturne when he's close, so don't stay in a prolonged fight relying on your ultimate alone.
Nocturne.laning: When ganking, hit the target first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, letting you close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. Check whether the enemy laners can rotate, and keep vision in the river and at jungle entrances to prepare for Nocturne's engage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When the screen goes dark from Nocturne R Paranoia, immediately move toward your allies so you aren't isolated. Right after Nocturne engages on your allied carry, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of them by knocking back enemies who aren't Challenged. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity applies only to champions outside spear range, so check whether Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down when fighting Nocturne up close.
Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne moves faster on its trail, so don't run straight away; turn toward an ally or turret. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and grants more attack speed when it blocks one, so don't immediately use the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. While Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is tethered to you, create distance and break the tether before the fear triggers.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main damage from P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the duel runs long, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items to counter her healing. Armor does not block the magic damage from Briar E Chilling Scream or R Certain Death.
Briar.combo: At range, mark Briar with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once close, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and knock her up with the sequence: basic attack, Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, basic attack, third hit. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, but keep in mind that it won’t block damage from Briar when she is close.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Also account for Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death as ways for her to get away. In particular, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge before Briar R Certain Death comes back up, then use Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and R Crescent Guard.
Briar.fight: Close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge after Briar’s mobility and crowd control are down. When Briar charges E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike to prevent her healing and a wall stun. Even if you can’t kill Briar, chipping away at her health in the jungle can delay her next route.
Briar.laning: Secure vision and push the lane to create a chance to counter Briar’s reckless ganks. When Xin Zhao ganks, first hit a distant target with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then follow with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Don’t linger in the middle of the lane where you have no vision.
Briar.teamfight: Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack targets the nearest enemy, so stand on the frontline to protect your allied backline damage dealers. If Briar reaches an allied damage dealer, knock her away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Before engaging, check whether Briar’s key crowd control is down, and keep in mind that Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity does not apply against Briar when she is close.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush stuns and reduces resistances, so watch your spacing to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, interrupt it with the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and avoid taking the fully charged scream with your back to a wall. If you’re hit by the bloodstone from Briar R Certain Death, stay close to your allies and fight back together.
Briar.phase: In the mid game, it’s safer for Xin Zhao to clear camps and set up skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because you’ll be vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Wukong Q Crushing Blow, W Warrior Trickster, and R Cyclone. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of stacking health alone. If Wukong P Stone Skin’s healing makes him hard to kill, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
MonkeyKing.escape: In particular, look for an opportunity before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up: engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, then chain Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. In teamfights, Wukong R Cyclone being down is your chance to engage and force a fight.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin stacks armor and healing as attacks continue, so look for short trades where you deal damage and back off. Close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up, especially when Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down. If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, don’t rely only on Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity to stay in a close fight.
MonkeyKing.laning: If the enemy is forward in lane and your ally has crowd control, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If river vision makes a direct engage difficult, first hit the enemy with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then engage using the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and create skirmishes around objectives, looking for a fight when Wukong R Cyclone is down. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so avoid engaging alone.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from your allies and engage after he uses it. If Wukong reaches an allied damage dealer, use the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of them. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to champions outside the spear’s range, so you can still take damage and crowd control from Wukong when he is close.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so it can’t be dodged while you’re in range, and the following Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster stays in place, so check the real Wukong’s direction of movement before using Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning and Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
MonkeyKing.combo: At close range, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then use basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock Wukong up. At long range, hit Wukong’s real body with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, then follow with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and land the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in when you need to survive.

Nidalee.build: Nidalee heals with E Primal Surge, so buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Nidalee’s damage. The provided information is not enough to determine a specific first core item.
Nidalee.combo: If you can get close, knock Nidalee up with the sequence: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Q Three Talon Strike → basic attack → W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third hit. If Nidalee is far away, first hit her with the thrust from W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark her as Challenged, then follow with the increased range of E Audacious Charge. Don’t use R Crescent Guard before engaging; activate it after you get close when you need to survive.
Nidalee.escape: Right after making Nidalee use her mobility tool, W Pounce, is your chance to close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Nidalee has no crowd control, so after she uses Pounce, catch her with the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Nidalee.fight: Start the fight after avoiding Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and W Bushwhack. Right after Nidalee uses W Pounce, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and knock her up with the third hit of Q Three Talon Strike. If Nidalee marks you and jumps in first, use Q Three Talon Strike and R Crescent Guard to respond.
Nidalee.laning: Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack around the river and jungle entrances; check for traps with a Control Ward or area-of-effect ability before entering. Don’t overreach with a counter-jungle if the enemy laner is positioned to join.
Nidalee.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and look for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, you become vulnerable after R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone. The provided information is not enough to determine which of Nidalee or Xin Zhao is stronger at each stage of the game.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee steps out to throw Q Javelin Toss, then look for an angle to catch her after she uses W Pounce. Use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to push away enemies who aren’t Challenged and clear space in front of your allied damage dealers. R Crescent Guard’s immunity applies to champions outside the spear’s range, so account for damage from enemies who are close when you engage.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther away she is, so don’t stand in a straight line with a distant Nidalee; keep minions or your allied frontline between you. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack as well to prevent her from marking you as Hunted. If you are marked, save Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and R Crescent Guard for when Nidalee uses W Pounce to engage.

Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel’Veth Q Void Surge and E Royal Maelstrom. If Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet’s healing makes her difficult to finish off, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet’s true damage cannot be blocked by resistances, so build some health as well.
Belveth.combo: If Bel’Veth is far away, hit her first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, follow with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, then continue with empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. To engage at close range, knock her up with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → an attack with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike active → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → an attack → the third attack. Don’t dump your damage into her while Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active.
Belveth.escape: The window to engage is after Bel’Veth W Above and Below misses and Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is down. Close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up, and look for a knockup with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below to the side, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and knock her up with the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, wait for it to end instead of using all your damage into it.
Belveth.laning: Early on, invade Bel’Veth’s jungle or skirmish with her to steal camps and slow her growth before she builds stacks. Check whether the enemy laners can rotate before making a move. When ganking, hit a distant target with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust to apply Challenge, then engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Belveth.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and look for skirmishes around objectives. Bel’Veth P Death in Lavender’s stacks are permanent, making you increasingly disadvantaged as time goes on, so don’t expect the same opportunities to fight in the late game as you had early on.
Belveth.teamfight: Engage after Bel’Veth W Above and Below is down, and activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in. If Bel’Veth dives your allied damage dealers, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock her away if she doesn’t have a Challenge mark, clearing space in front of your allies. If Bel’Veth has transformed after getting a Void Coral, delay the team fight. In the late game, consider what happens after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s duration ends and avoid engaging alone.
Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets the cooldown of Bel’Veth Q Void Surge, so if she closes in, dodge to the side instead of retreating in a straight line. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes, so don’t spend your spells into it; wait for it to end.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand’s damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone, and consider movement speed to dodge area attacks.
Brand.combo: Against a nearby Brand, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then knock Brand up with an attack, Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, an attack, and the third attack. If Brand is far away, apply a Challenge mark first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you need Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, activate it after closing in.
Brand.escape: Engage when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and you can dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear. Brand has no mobility skill, so close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and lock him down with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you’re ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear before engaging, then knock Brand up with the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike once you’re close.
Brand.laning: When ganking, if Brand has stepped forward in lane and your ally has crowd control, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If a frontal engage is difficult, hit Brand first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust to apply Challenge, then follow with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Move away from burning minions, as Brand E Conflagration can spread from them.
Brand.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and look for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, Xin Zhao is vulnerable once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. Go in after Brand Q Sear is down, and if you’re surrounded, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard once you’re close. If an enemy dives your allied damage dealers, knock them away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze builds stacks and explodes when you’re hit by spells in quick succession, so dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and watch for follow-up spells. If you’re ablaze, move out of the line of Brand Q Sear’s projectile, which stuns, or hide behind a minion. When an ally is burning, spread out to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing.

Diana.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can more easily leave the marked attack area. If you build resistances, build magic resistance against Diana’s magic damage.
Diana.combo: Against a nearby Diana, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Q Three Talon Strike, then knock her up with a basic attack → W Wind Becomes Lightning → a basic attack → the third basic attack. If she is far away, hit her first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust to apply Challenge, then follow with E Audacious Charge. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to survive.
Diana.escape: The window to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark from Q Crescent Strike. In team fights, it’s safer to engage after Diana R Moonfall is down. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, create distance because she may use E Lunar Rush again.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and fight when the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without marking you, lock her down with the slow from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning and the knockup from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If Diana R Moonfall is available, account for its crowd control before engaging.
Diana.laning: When ganking from far away, hit the target with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Diana.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and look for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, don’t engage alone because you’ll be vulnerable once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Diana.teamfight: Space yourselves based on Diana R Moonfall’s engage angle so multiple allies aren’t pulled in together. If Diana dives your allied damage dealers, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock her away and clear space in front of your allies, without applying a Challenge mark to her first. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to champions outside spear range, so don’t expect it to block damage from a nearby Diana.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it travels, so dodge to the side instead of only backing away. If you’re hit and marked, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so create distance. Don’t fight Diana up close right after she activates Diana W Pale Cascade; wait until the orbs and shield are gone.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s damage. If you can’t use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to get out of Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area, prioritize tenacity over resistances. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing makes him difficult to kill, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Ekko.combo: Against a distant Ekko, apply a Challenge mark with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then follow with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. At close range, knock him up with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → an attack with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike active → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → an attack → the third attack. If he has just used Ekko E Phase Dive, look for a chance to land the third attack.
Ekko.escape: Engage after Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down to avoid its stun. Don’t chase deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down; close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge during the window when Ekko R Chronobreak is also down. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, account for the fact that Ekko R Chronobreak is ready.
Ekko.fight: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area, and dodge the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder as well. Right after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, he has no mobility skill available, so look for an opportunity to knock him up with the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and fight.
Ekko.laning: If the enemy is forward and your ally has crowd control, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and look for the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If a frontal engage is difficult, hit them first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust and engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Ekko.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and set up skirmishes around objectives, and start fights when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because you’ll be vulnerable once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Ekko.teamfight: Engage after Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down. If Ekko uses E Phase Dive to reach your allied damage dealers, respond with the knockup from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in, and keep in mind that nearby enemies can still deal damage and apply crowd control.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to prevent its stun and shield. Move out of the path of Ekko Q Timewinder as it returns. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if health is low.

Evelynn.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Evelynn’s main damage. If Evelynn P Demon Shade’s healing makes her difficult to kill, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items, and avoid relying on stacking health alone because of Evelynn E Whiplash.
Evelynn.combo: Against a distant Evelynn, hit her with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Evelynn.escape: The window to engage is after Evelynn W Allure is down. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so close the distance with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge especially before Evelynn R Last Caress is available again.
Evelynn.fight: Move away while the mark from Evelynn W Allure is charging, and fight after dodging the charm. Hitting her with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust to apply Challenge lets you close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Evelynn.laning: When ganking, if the enemy is far away or has vision of the river, hit them first with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Evelynn.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and set up skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, don’t engage alone, because you’ll be vulnerable once the immunity from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Evelynn.teamfight: If Evelynn dives your allied backline damage dealers, look for a knockup with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and if Evelynn doesn’t have a Challenge mark, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock her away and clear space in front of your damage dealers. If you need to engage first, check that Evelynn W Allure is down, then activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in.
Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, retreat toward your allies’ vision before the charm lands. Evelynn E Whiplash after the charm deals damage based on maximum health, and when health has decreased, also watch out for the heavy damage from Evelynn R Last Caress.

Fiddlesticks.build: Because of the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Fiddlesticks’ damage. If you take sustained damage from Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm because of Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap’s silence, prioritize tenacity.
Fiddlesticks.combo: To approach a distant Fiddlesticks, use the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → attacks with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike active.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is also down, it’s an opportunity to land the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Fiddlesticks.fight: After Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge while Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is unavailable. When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt the channel with the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Fiddlesticks.laning: When ganking, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to mark the target as Challenged, then follow up with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Fiddlesticks is out of sight, keep the brush behind the lane warded. Don’t walk close to a stationary Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow until you’ve checked it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the mid game, clear camps while preparing for fights around objectives, but watch for Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in brush and approaches near objectives, and spread out so Fiddlesticks’ area-of-effect abilities don’t hit you all together. Engage after Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down. When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm starts, interrupt it or retreat outside its area. If an enemy dives onto an allied damage dealer, knock them away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Keep in mind that the ultimate’s damage immunity does not block damage or crowd control from enemies within spear range.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels before entering, so if you see it being cast, interrupt it with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s knock-up or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback. If you can’t interrupt it, move outside its area. When Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a long time, watch for ambushes in brush where there is no vision and narrow passages.

Gragas.build: Since Gragas tends to have high armor, include penetration to make the most of Xin Zhao’s physical damage. Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter healing from Gragas P Happy Hour. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Gragas’ damage. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health.
Gragas.combo: To reach a distant Gragas, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. To engage at close range, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → attack → third attack to knock him up. Don’t use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard before engaging; activate it after you’re in range when you need survivability and knockback.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam is his mobility tool, so close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge right after you force him to use it. In teamfights, engage after Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask are down. Gragas E Body Slam’s cooldown is greatly reduced if he collides with an enemy, so don’t let the chase drag on.
Gragas.fight: Save your burst while Gragas drinks with Gragas W Drunken Rage, and attack after its damage reduction ends. If Gragas E Body Slam is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and knock him up with the third attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, move out of the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll first instead of fighting back on the spot.
Gragas.laning: If the enemy has river vision, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to mark the target as Challenged, then engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. When Gragas retreats, Gragas E Body Slam may come back up, so only chase deep when you can secure the kill.
Gragas.phase: In the early and mid game, Gragas has strong burst and formation disruption, so fight near objectives without scattering. In the late game, Gragas’ sustained damage falls off, but Xin Zhao has trouble surviving after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so avoid engaging alone.
Gragas.teamfight: Engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge after Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask are down. If Gragas dives onto an allied damage dealer, knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of them. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to champions outside spear range, so watch for nearby enemies and their crowd control as well.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius before it explodes. If you’re near the barrel and also hit by Gragas E Body Slam, the damage and crowd control overlap. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask ready, don’t position with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.

Graves.build: Graves’ main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Armor does not apply to the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.combo: To reach a distant Graves, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to mark him as Challenged, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. Follow up by activating Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and landing three empowered attacks to knock him up with the third hit. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to block damage coming from outside spear range.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, Graves can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so track both mobility tools. In particular, before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up, leave the area of Graves W Smoke Screen as well, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Graves.fight: Look for a chance to counterattack while Graves reloads after firing two shots. His basic attacks stop at the first unit they hit, so if possible, fight with minions or allies between you. In open terrain, slow him with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then follow up with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Graves.laning: If river vision makes a direct engage difficult, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to increase the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Graves is spotted on the other side of the map, you can target his camps, but first check whether the enemy laner can rotate.
Graves.phase: Graves grows stronger as he stacks Graves E Quickdraw, putting Xin Zhao at a disadvantage as the game goes on. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Graves.teamfight: When fighting Graves, avoid walls and narrow passages, and if possible, keep minions or allies between you to block his basic attacks. If an enemy dives onto an allied damage dealer, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock away enemies who aren’t Challenged. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity applies to champions outside spear range, so watch for the damage and crowd control of nearby enemies too.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall and avoid narrow jungle chokepoints. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route, then engage again. Graves E Quickdraw can create distance and stack armor, so don’t engage hastily while he still has mobility available.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first against Hecarim’s main damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread.
Hecarim.combo: To reach a distant Hecarim, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to mark him as Challenged, then engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Keep in mind that a Challenged Hecarim is excluded from the knockback of Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so track both mobility abilities. In particular, before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge while Hecarim E Devastating Charge is also down, and look for a knock-up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, slow Hecarim with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning or Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to reduce both his approach speed and damage. Activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in on him, but keep in mind it won’t block damage from a nearby Hecarim.
Hecarim.laning: If Hecarim is confirmed clearing camps on the other side of the map, target camps on the side opposite Hecarim, but first check whether an enemy laner can rotate.
Hecarim.phase: In the mid game, it’s safer to clear camps while creating opportunities for fights around objectives. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t hit multiple allies, and engage after Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows are down. If Hecarim dives onto an allied damage dealer, knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of them. If you marked Hecarim as Challenged with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard won’t knock him back, so decide who to mark first.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he has run, so when Hecarim turns and starts charging, break vision or move close to your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear grouped allies all at once, so spread out. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, he heals from damage dealt nearby, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight near him.

Ivern.build: Against Ivern, consider tenacity first because the paths along which allies join after roots and knock-ups are dangerous. To resist damage from Ivern’s abilities, choose magic resistance over armor. Move speed is also useful for escaping from marked areas.
Ivern.combo: Against a distant target, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to mark them as Challenged, then use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard and knock back enemies who aren’t Challenged.
Ivern.escape: The window to engage opens just after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down. Check whether Ivern R Daisy!’s knock-up is also down. If the target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, wait for the shield to burst before engaging with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Ivern.fight: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed bursts, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once in range, knock him up with the third empowered attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard if you’re surrounded. Look for a chance to pick off an ally protected by a shield instead of chasing Ivern too far.
Ivern.laning: If you ward Ivern’s jungle early, you can read his path as he comes to harvest camps where he planted seeds. Watch for ambushes around brush that appears suddenly from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: In the mid game, clear camps while looking for fights around objectives. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Ivern.teamfight: Engage after Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! are down. If an enemy dives onto an allied damage dealer, knock them away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. After you’re surrounded, use it to block damage coming from outside spear range. Damage and crowd control from nearby melee champions still get through, so don’t engage relying only on Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so stand with minions or terrain between you before he casts it. When engaging a target shielded by Ivern E Triggerseed, you may also be slowed when the shield bursts, so delay your engage until it bursts. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move away to avoid the knock-up from three consecutive attacks.

JarvanIV.build: Later, building health also increases the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination.
JarvanIV.combo: If you start at close range, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike → attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → attack → third empowered attack to knock the target up. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
JarvanIV.laning: When ganking, hit the target with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then follow up with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard only knocks back enemies who aren’t Challenged, so check whom you marked with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity won’t block damage from nearby melee champions, so don’t go deep alone.

Jax.build: Prioritize ways to reduce attack speed to mitigate Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. The data alone isn’t enough to determine a specific first purchase.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning from a distance to mark Jax as Challenged, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Follow up by activating Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and landing three basic attacks to set up the third-hit knock-up. If Jax E Counter Strike activates during the fight, stop basic attacking and move outside the stun radius.
Jax.escape: Jax Q Leap Strike is his mobility tool, so the moment after he uses it is your window to close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you engage after the stun from Jax E Counter Strike ends, Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s basic attacks won’t be dodged.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If Jax has also used Jax Q Leap Strike, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and land the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike while Counter Strike is unavailable.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee fight, so don’t force an engage when you only have one ability. When ganking, mark the target as Challenged first with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to increase the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Jax.phase: In the late game, avoid engaging alone because Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike to dive onto an allied damage dealer, don’t group up in the area of Jax E Counter Strike’s AoE stun, and layer your crowd control after Counter Strike ends. You can knock away a Jax who isn’t Challenged with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of your allied damage dealer. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity won’t block damage or crowd control from a nearby Jax, so don’t force an engage while Jax E Counter Strike is still available.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges basic attacks and the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and its recast damage increases with each attack dodged. Stop basic attacking and move outside the stun radius while you wait for Counter Strike to end.

Karthus.build: Get move speed first to make it easier to dodge the marked area of Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus W Wall of Pain. Karthus’ main damage is magic, so choose magic resistance if building resistances. However, Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces that resistance when you’re hit, so avoiding the wall and leaving Karthus E Defile quickly take priority.
Karthus.combo: Against a nearby Karthus, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and use Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → attack → third attack to knock him up. If he’s far away, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to mark him as Challenged, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. If you enter a group of enemies, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in to knock back enemies who aren’t Challenged.
Karthus.escape: If Karthus W Wall of Pain is placed, engage along a path that doesn’t cross the wall.
Karthus.fight: Karthus can’t create distance on his own, so close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and follow up with empowered attacks. Move away from the marked area of Karthus Q Lay Waste to dodge its damage, and don’t chase through Karthus W Wall of Pain. Karthus tends to have low armor, making him vulnerable to Xin Zhao’s physical damage, but after killing him, move away from his corpse until Karthus P Death Defied ends.
Karthus.laning: If the target is far away, hit with the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning first to increase the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Karthus.phase: In the mid game, account for Karthus’ fast farming and Karthus R Requiem as you clear camps and look for fights around objectives. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Karthus.teamfight: Karthus can still cast abilities after death with Karthus P Death Defied, so move away from his corpse with your team and reposition immediately after killing him. Look for a chance to clear the frontline before entering the range of Karthus E Defile. If Xin Zhao engages, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after closing in, and knock away enemies diving onto allied damage dealers.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk away when you see its detonation marker or overlap with a minion or ally. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance and slows, so go around the wall, and don’t stay in Karthus E Defile’s area for long. Because of Karthus P Death Defied, he can still hit you with abilities near his corpse immediately after being killed, so move away at once. After a fight, keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn transforms into Rhaast and sustains through fights, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Kayn.combo: Against a distant Kayn, hit him with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as challenged, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. At close range, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike-enhanced basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock him up. Don’t cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard before engaging; use it after you’re on top of him if you’re surrounded.
Kayn.escape: Engage after Kayn W Blade's Reach is down. If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, Kayn can still escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so look for an opening before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is ready and close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Kayn.fight: Pressure Kayn before he transforms by contesting early jungle camps and objectives, but check whether the enemy laners can rotate. Engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge after Kayn W Blade's Reach is down, and fight aggressively if Kayn R Umbral Trespass is not ready.
Kayn.laning: Take jungle camps and create opportunities for fights around objectives before Kayn transforms. If you confirm Kayn is on the opposite side, take camps on the other side and back off, but check the enemy laners’ positions for a possible rotation. If you see the warning for Kayn E Shadow Step along terrain edges, stop fighting and retreat toward a turret.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, giving Xin Zhao a chance to pressure jungle routes and objectives early. In mid game, check whether Kayn has transformed and, if he is Rhaast, prepare for the sustain in extended duels. In late game, Xin Zhao is vulnerable when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard expires, so avoid engaging alone.
Kayn.teamfight: Engage after Kayn W Blade's Reach is down. If Kayn dives onto an allied damage dealer, use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock away enemies who haven’t been challenged. An ally caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass can’t be helped while Kayn is inside, so be ready to knock Kayn up with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike when he emerges near his target. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to enemies outside spear range, so watch for nearby melee champions too.
Kayn.watch: Kayn W Blade's Reach slows and knocks you up. If it hits, Kayn can follow with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so avoid standing in its line. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on health alone to stay in a prolonged fight.

Khazix.build: Build armor first against the damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, Kha'Zix W Void Spike, and Kha'Zix E Leap. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. If Kha'Zix W Void Spike’s healing makes him hard to kill, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Khazix.combo: After Kha'Zix E Leap is down, if he’s far away, hit him with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as challenged, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. At close range, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike-enhanced basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock him up. If you’re surrounded after engaging, cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is your window to close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Use the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. If an ally was picked off first and Kha'Zix E Leap is evolved, its cooldown may reset on a takedown, so be cautious when counterattacking.
Khazix.fight: Fight near an ally or minion to reduce the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Once Kha'Zix E Leap is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and knock him up with the third empowered basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, don’t chase recklessly; look for an opening the moment he reappears.
Khazix.laning: Move with allies to avoid Kha'Zix’s isolated damage, and avoid making your position predictable by clearing jungle camps alone. When ganking a distant target, hit them with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as challenged, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Khazix.phase: Avoid acting alone from mid game onward, once Kha'Zix has at least two evolutions. In late game, Xin Zhao is vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard expires, so don’t engage alone.
Khazix.teamfight: Fight grouped with your team in narrow areas where you have vision, and stay near your backline damage dealers so they aren’t isolated. If Kha'Zix E Leap puts him on an allied damage dealer, protect them by knocking him up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to champions outside spear range, so don’t engage assuming it will block the damage and crowd control of nearby enemies.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you’re isolated, so fight near an ally or minion. Secure vision in river and jungle entrance brushes to reduce the threat from the empowered basic attack and slow of Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay with your team and counterattack when he reappears.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite healing prolong the duel, build armor first, then fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Kindred.combo: At close range, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then use basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock her up. From a distance, hit her first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to extend Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge’s range, then follow with the same basic attack sequence.
Kindred.escape: If only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, she can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don’t rush your engage. Close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is ready, then knock her up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Kindred.fight: Before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is ready, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge while Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is also down. Knock her up with the third empowered basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after engaging to block damage from outside spear range.
Kindred.laning: Ward the enemy jungle and track Kindred’s route. If Kindred P Mark of the Kindred marks a jungle monster, take the camp first or use nearby vision to block her approach, but check whether the enemy laners can rotate.
Kindred.phase: In mid game, clear camps and create skirmishes around objectives, delaying Kindred’s marks to slow her mid- to late-game damage and range growth. In late game, Xin Zhao is vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard expires, so don’t engage alone.
Kindred.teamfight: When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, even low-health allies can survive inside the zone, so go in together. As the zone ends, if Kindred isn’t challenged by Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, you can knock her out of it with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. If an enemy dives onto an allied damage dealer, clear the way with the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied and you keep taking hits, it deals heavy damage based on your missing health. The lower your health, the more you should back away or break vision. Kindred can keep creating distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don’t fight there for long.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If you expect to take many basic attacks, reducing his attack speed is also effective.
LeeSin.combo: Against a distant target, hit them with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. At close range, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike-enhanced basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock them up. If you’re surrounded after engaging, cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard and keep watching for damage from nearby melee champions like Lee Sin.
LeeSin.escape: Your window to engage is when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike has missed or isn’t ready. If Lee Sin has just used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to move, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and look for the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. In teamfights, engage after Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is down.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the early jungle, don’t immediately commit to a duel. If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or isn’t ready, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available, he can escape, so also check whether he has used it when focusing your damage.
LeeSin.laning: When a gank is likely, stand behind minions in lane to reduce Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike’s direct line. If the enemy is far away or you have vision of the river, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as challenged, then engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Avoid jungle fights where the enemy laners can rotate.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you meet him in the jungle. He falls off in late game, but Xin Zhao is also vulnerable when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard expires, so avoid engaging alone.
LeeSin.teamfight: Engage after Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is down, or use the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear the way in front of an allied damage dealer when Lee Sin dives onto them. Cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after you’re on top of enemies to block damage from outside spear range. Nearby Lee Sin can still deal damage and apply crowd control, so don’t rely on Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to dive too deep.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can engage from beyond walls with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, so stay away from walls you don’t have vision around. In teamfights, watch where Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage will knock you and keep track of your spacing from allies.

Lillia.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough. Build magic resistance first against Lillia’s main ability damage, and get some armor as well to account for her basic attack damage. Resistances can’t block the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, but be cautious about stacking health alone because Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on your max health.
Lillia.combo: If Lillia is far away, hit her first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. At close range, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock her up. Don’t cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard before engaging; use it after you’re on top of her if you need to survive.
Lillia.escape: Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is her mobility tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Engage after Lillia’s key crowd control is down, and don’t chase recklessly if she has built movement speed by repeatedly hitting abilities.
Lillia.fight: Look to fight when Lillia misses her abilities and can’t build movement speed stacks. Engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge right after Lillia uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, then knock her up with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If you’re surrounded after engaging, cast Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to block damage from outside spear range.
Lillia.laning: If Lillia is forward in lane and your ally has crowd control, gank with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If a direct engage is difficult, hit her first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark her as Challenged, then follow with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Lillia.phase: In mid game, clear camps and create skirmishes around objectives, engaging when Lillia misses abilities or uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. In late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable as soon as Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard expires, so avoid engaging alone.
Lillia.teamfight: Save the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike to catch Lillia when she comes in from the flank. If she dives onto an allied damage dealer, use the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to peel her away. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity only applies to champions outside spear range, so watch for Lillia’s crowd control and nearby enemies when you engage.
Lillia.watch: If you take hits from Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed, you give her movement speed stacks and help meet the condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. Check Lillia’s position before entering narrow jungle paths, and move to the side to avoid the center when you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! wind up. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby hits you, move to safety while you’re still able to move before you fall asleep.

MasterYi.build: Build health against the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and bring a way to reduce his attack speed. Fit Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter healing from Master Yi W Meditate.
MasterYi.combo: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then use basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack. If Master Yi uses Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt the channel with the knock-up from the third basic attack of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Save Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, which requires a target, while Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is active.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is a mobility tool, so the moment it ends is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Follow up on the landed Master Yi with the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and time it so you can use the knock-up against Master Yi W Meditate.
MasterYi.fight: Early on, you can take a fight if you meet Master Yi with your Xin Zhao abilities ready. Engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, then knock him up with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don’t count on slows to create distance.
MasterYi.laning: When ganking, check the enemy laner’s position and your ally’s crowd control before engaging with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If a direct engage is difficult, hit the target first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then follow with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Also check whether the enemy laners can rotate when looking to take camps on the opposite side of Master Yi.
MasterYi.phase: In mid game, clear camps and create skirmishes around objectives. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so in late game avoid engaging alone, keeping in mind when Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard will expire.
MasterYi.teamfight: After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, lock him down with the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Coordinate your team’s crowd control so you can also interrupt Master Yi W Meditate with a knock-up when he uses it. Prevent one ally from being picked off alone and letting Master Yi move on to another target. If Master Yi dives onto an allied damage dealer, peel him away with the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, but keep in mind that it won’t block damage from nearby melee champions.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so don’t cast Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge before he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, the slows from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning and Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge don’t work.

Nunu.build: Because of the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s primary damage, and get tenacity to account for the snowball’s crowd control.
Nunu.combo: Against Nunu & Willump at long range, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then close in with the extended range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Follow up with empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and knock them up with the third. If you start nearby, attack in this order: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike → basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack.
Nunu.escape: When Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down, that’s Xin Zhao’s chance to engage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge during that window. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you and you need to disengage, first check whether there’s a target in your escape direction for Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to dash to.
Nunu.fight: Engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge after the crowd control from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage is down. Once you’re in, knock them up with the third empowered attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and use the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination to sustain the fight. Nunu & Willump can restore health with Q Consume, so don’t rush to finish them without Grievous Wounds.
Nunu.laning: Stay alert even after one gank; they can return by way of the river crab.
Nunu.phase: In the mid game, clearing camps and setting up skirmishes around objectives is a stable strategy for Xin Zhao. In the late game, you’re vulnerable as soon as Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Nunu.teamfight: Engage after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, see if you can interrupt it with the third attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike; if you can’t, leave its area. If an enemy is on your allied damage dealers, knock them away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard if you’re surrounded after engaging.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up from long range, so when you see it, don’t just run straight backward; dodge toward the path Nunu & Willump came from. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move out immediately before the delayed root lands. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero applies an increasingly strong slow, so leave its area if you can’t interrupt it.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. Health items also increase the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination. Rammus has high armor, so don’t take extended fights expecting physical damage alone to kill him.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends and his crowd control is down, if he’s far away, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged. Then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Q Three Talon Strike, and knock him up with the third empowered attack. At close range, use E Audacious Charge → Q Three Talon Strike basic attack → W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack.
Rammus.escape: The moment Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are down is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Rammus R Soaring Slam is down too, close the gap during that window and knock him up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If you’re already taunted, you can’t issue movement commands or use abilities, so plan your path for when the taunt ends.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t use the attack speed from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to unload basic attacks; back off briefly instead. Deal your damage after W ends, and engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge if Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are down. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, but account for the fact that nearby enemies’ damage and crowd control still affect you.
Rammus.laning: Keep minions between you and the path of Rammus Q Powerball, and look for an opening outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt’s range. If you need to approach from far away, hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, then follow up with the increased range of E Audacious Charge.
Rammus.phase: In the mid game, start fights when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends or when Q Powerball, E Frenzying Taunt, and R Soaring Slam are down. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because you’re vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Rammus.teamfight: Engage after Rammus Q Powerball, E Frenzying Taunt, and R Soaring Slam are down, or knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard as soon as he gets on an allied damage dealer. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t hit him with basic attacks; target someone else. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard grants immunity to damage only from champions outside your spear’s range, so don’t go in assuming it will block crowd control from a nearby Rammus.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him to block the collision. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is targeted and can’t be dodged, so don’t carelessly enter its range. Rammus R Soaring Slam has a wider area after he builds speed with Q Powerball, so back away early and immediately leave the landing area too.

RekSai.build: Build armor first to withstand Rek’Sai’s primary damage. Armor doesn’t mitigate the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If her healing is interfering with fights, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
RekSai.combo: Against Rek’Sai at long range, hit with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Follow up with three empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and knock her up with the last hit. Use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard when you need to survive after engaging.
RekSai.escape: The moment after you dodge the knockup from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Don’t chase just because Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down; check whether she can still use R Void Rush. In particular, close the gap and pressure her with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and R Crescent Guard before Rek’Sai R Void Rush comes back up.
RekSai.fight: While Rek’Sai is Burrowed, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge when you can dodge her knockup. After dodging it, knock her up with the third empowered attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and keep fighting with the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination. If Rek’Sai Burrows again to heal, don’t give her space; keep dealing damage.
RekSai.laning: In the early game, don’t push your lane too hard or walk alone through areas without vision, so Rek’Sai can’t get a kill with a gank. If you find the entrance to a Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnel near a lane or your allied jungle, step on it to destroy it. When ganking, you can first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to extend the engage range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
RekSai.phase: In the early game, Rek’Sai tries to build an advantage through ganks, so it’s important not to give up kills. The longer the game goes, the better you can handle Rek’Sai, but Xin Zhao is vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends in the late game, so don’t go in alone.
RekSai.teamfight: If Rek’Sai gets on an allied damage dealer, look for an angle to knock her away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. If you’ve marked Rek’Sai as Challenged with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, account for Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard not knocking her away. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity applies to champions outside your spear’s range, so don’t expect it to block the damage and crowd control of a nearby Rek’Sai.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai is Burrowed, watch out for the knockup as Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow makes her emerge. Avoid walls and narrow paths, and move into open space; look for an angle to dodge with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge as she emerges. Don’t use targeted abilities on Rek’Sai while she is leaping with Rek’Sai R Void Rush.

Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s primary damage. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar, and its effectiveness is reduced while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt shreds your resistances. If Rengar W Battle Roar’s healing makes him hard to kill, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Rengar.combo: If Rengar W Battle Roar is down and you’ve dodged Rengar E Bola Strike, at long range use Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust → Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Once you’re in, land three empowered attacks and knock him up with the third. If you start nearby, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike → basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack.
Rengar.escape: Engage when you’ve dodged Rengar E Bola Strike and he has no Ferocity. If Rengar W Battle Roar is down too, you have less to worry about from its healing and crowd control removal; close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and pin him down with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar has no Ferocity and immediately after Rengar W Battle Roar is spent. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and follow through to the third attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to survive after engaging, but keep in mind it won’t block damage from a nearby Rengar.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside bushes and use Control Wards to reveal them. When ganking a distant target, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to extend the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Check whether the enemy laner can join before you fight.
Rengar.phase: In the mid game, clear camps and set up for skirmishes around objectives; check Rengar’s Ferocity and Rengar E Bola Strike before fighting. Avoid engaging alone in the late game because you’re vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends. The information available doesn’t establish whether Xin Zhao or Rengar is stronger in each of the early, mid, and late game.
Rengar.teamfight: Immediately after Rengar leaps onto an allied damage dealer, knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard and clear space in front of your ally. If you intend to knock Rengar away, don’t first mark him as Challenged with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. Engage after Rengar E Bola Strike is down, and account for the fact that Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s immunity won’t block damage from a nearby Rengar.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from bushes and build Ferocity, so avoid paths beside bushes when you can’t see him. At full Ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike roots, and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so avoid trading damage then. When Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, don’t move around alone while injured; stay with allies and overlap your vision.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s primary damage. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, which magic resistance doesn’t mitigate. Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Sejuani.combo: For a nearby gank, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then knock the target up with a basic attack, Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, another basic attack, and the third basic attack. Against Sejuani at long range, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark her as Challenged, then follow up with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
