If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to knock away enemies who aren’t Challenged.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after you bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your window to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. In teamfights, engage after key crowd control such as Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, E Permafrost, and R Glacial Prison is down. If you use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to retreat, first check whether there’s a minion or jungle monster in the direction you’re escaping that you can target.
Sejuani.fight: While Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor is active, her defenses are high and slows don’t affect her. Damage her first to break the armor, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge while Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down. Dodge the second hit of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, and knock her up with the third attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Sejuani.laning: When ganking a distant target, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If the target steps forward and your ally has crowd control, follow up with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If you confirm Sejuani is clearing camps on the opposite side, take a camp and leave, but check whether the enemy laner can join.
Sejuani.phase: In the mid game, it’s safer to clear camps and set up a skirmish around objectives. In the late game, you become vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Sejuani.teamfight: Engage after Sejuani’s key crowd control is down, and if she gets on an allied damage dealer, knock her away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard blocks damage from champions outside your spear’s range, but it doesn’t block damage or crowd control from nearby enemies. So if Sejuani’s melee allies are still alive, don’t go deep relying on Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard alone.
Sejuani.watch: When you see the tell for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or R Glacial Prison, move sideways to dodge. If Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath’s first hit lands, get out of its range before the second hit. If attacks from Sejuani and her melee allies build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, create distance before you’re stunned.

Shaco.build: Prepare Control Wards and Oracle Lens to clear Shaco W Jack In The Box boxes around objectives. Prioritize magic resistance against Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate, and get health to avoid entering the health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals increased damage.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is down, if he’s far away, hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning and engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If he’s nearby, use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Q Three Talon Strike and basic attack → W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack to knock him up. If you’re surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Shaco.escape: The moment Shaco appears with Q Deceive is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Engaging after Shaco W Jack In The Box and R Hallucinate fear are down reduces the risk of being hit by crowd control. If Shaco appears, immediately focus your damage on the real one with your allies.
Shaco.fight: As soon as Shaco Q Deceive is down, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once you’re in, knock him up with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, and activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard if you’re surrounded. Delay your engage if fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or R Hallucinate is still available.
Shaco.laning: In the early game, maintain vision at your allied jungle entrances to watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades. If your gank target is far away, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then follow up with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Avoid counterjungling where the enemy laner can join the fight.
Shaco.phase: In the early game, watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades, avoid giving up kills, and secure camps and objectives. Shaco is weaker in isolated fights late in the game, but Xin Zhao is also vulnerable after R Crescent Guard ends, so don’t engage alone.
Shaco.teamfight: Engage after Shaco W Jack In The Box and R Hallucinate fear are down. If Shaco gets on an allied damage dealer, knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives. If Shaco Q Deceive gets behind you, his empowered basic attack is dangerous, so keep a wall behind you or face toward your allies. When Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone dies, it explodes and leaves boxes behind, so move away immediately.

Shyvana.build: Because of the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon’s Descent, and get armor too to account for her basic attack damage.
Shyvana.combo: Against Shyvana at long range, first hit with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark her as Challenged, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then knock her up with basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack. Don’t use Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard before engaging; activate it after you’re in when you need to survive.
Shyvana.escape: Don’t use crowd control while Shyvana is dashing with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent; pin her down after she lands. When Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty and she can’t transform, that’s a good window to pressure her. Keep looking for a counterattack after Dragon Form ends and she returns to human form.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty, and close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge when you have an opening to pin her down. If she engages with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, knock her up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike after she lands. Activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard when you’re in the enemy formation and surrounded.
Shyvana.laning: In the early game, clear camps and create fights around objectives; if you confirm Shyvana is on the opposite side, look for a chance to take her camps. Check whether the enemy laner can join, and don’t start attacking an objective in front of Shyvana if her Fury bar is full.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana becomes stronger than Xin Zhao as the game goes on, so pressure camps and objectives early, before she has stacks.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so several allies aren’t hit together by Shyvana’s R Dragon’s Descent path and empowered area abilities. If Shyvana gets on an allied damage dealer, push her away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of your ally, as long as she isn’t marked as Challenged. When you engage directly, keep in mind Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard won’t block damage from a nearby Shyvana.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with R Dragon’s Descent, so don’t try to interrupt her engage; knock her up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike after she lands. Shyvana Q Emberstrike and E Molten Burst deal damage based on your maximum health, while Shyvana W Inferno Aegis grants a shield and healing, so be careful about staying close and taking extended fights.

Skarner.build: If you're worried about Skarner R Impale suppressing you, decide first whether to buy Quicksilver Sash. Prioritize magic resistance to deal with Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale, and avoid stacking health alone.
Skarner.combo: Against a nearby target, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then knock them up with this sequence: basic attack, Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, basic attack, third basic attack. Against a distant Skarner, hit him first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, then follow with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. Use this combo while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. In teamfights, check that Skarner R Impale is also down before engaging. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact knocked you into a wall, retreat while accounting for his next dash.
Skarner.fight: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and follow through to the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Don't trade for long while Skarner stays on you and builds up empowered basic attacks. Don't dive in relying only on the damage immunity from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to absorb Skarner's melee damage or crowd control.
Skarner.laning: If your gank target is far away or river vision makes a direct approach difficult, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to extend the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you spot Skarner farming camps on the opposite side, check whether the enemy laners can rotate, then take the camps on the other side and leave.
Skarner.phase: As Skarner builds tank items, both his damage and durability increase, so delaying his item timings is important in the mid game. Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable in the late game after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so avoid engaging alone.
Skarner.teamfight: Engage after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down. If Skarner gets on your allied carry, use the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of them. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity applies to champions outside spear range, so stay wary of attacks and crowd control from Skarner when he's close.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns if he collides with a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. If Skarner R Impale grabs you, you can't escape with a mobility spell, so be especially careful when you enter its range. Create distance so Skarner can't stay on top of you and keep hitting you with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against Taliyah's main damage. Xin Zhao can move with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, so you don't have to follow the usual priority on tenacity for champions without mobility spells.
Taliyah.combo: Against a distant Taliyah, mark her as Challenged with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. For a close-range gank, knock her up with this sequence: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → empowered basic attack with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike active → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → empowered basic attack → third empowered basic attack. If the rock field is laid down, don't dash across it with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Taliyah.escape: The window after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If only one of Taliyah's escape tools is down, check for the remaining one, and especially look for a chance before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back up. Continually damaging Taliyah can also prevent her from escaping with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.fight: While Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, hold off on engaging with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and go around the rock field. Once Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down, mark her as Challenged with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. After you get on her, knock her up with the third empowered basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike.
Taliyah.laning: If Taliyah moves quickly near a wall or disappears into the jungle, she may be setting up a play in another lane, so retreat in advance. If she's pushed up in lane and your ally has crowd control, gank with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. If there is vision in the river, hit her first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to increase your engage range.
Taliyah.phase: In the mid game, farm camps and look for skirmishes around objectives, taking advantage of the window when Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don't engage alone.
Taliyah.teamfight: Engage after Taliyah's key crowd control, such as Taliyah W Seismic Shove, Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, is down. If you're surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to block damage from enemies outside spear range. If enemies get on your allied carry, knock them away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, keeping in mind that damage and crowd control from nearby enemies still affect you.
Taliyah.watch: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, don't dash across the rock field with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change direction, so dodge it by moving to the side.

Udyr.build: If Udyr's healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle makes him difficult to finish off when you need to kill him, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build armor first against Udyr's main damage, but armor alone can't block all of the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm or the mixed damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. Both attacks deal damage based on maximum health, so think carefully before stacking health alone.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, if you can get close, knock him up with this sequence: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack. If he's far away, mark him as Challenged with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then follow with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is in its awakened state, land Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's knock-up after the awakening ends.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede provides both a stun and movement, so the moment after he uses it is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you've already absorbed the stun once, use the period when the same target can't be stunned again for a while. After the awakening of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, block his escape with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Udyr.fight: After you’ve absorbed Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun once, or immediately after baiting him into using that ability, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, pressure him with empowered basic attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to reduce his opportunities to heal. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity can’t block damage from Udyr when he’s on top of you, so don’t fight relying on that immunity alone.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is missing, track his path with vision on key routes and jungle entrances, and don't push too far up in lane before you spot him. If you spot him farming camps on the opposite side, take the camps on the other side and leave, but first check whether the enemy laners can rotate.
Udyr.teamfight: Engage after Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun is down. Rather than trying to force down Udyr first while he's tough from defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, take out the weaker enemies behind him, then take him down with a numbers advantage. If Udyr gets on your allied carry, you can knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, but Challenged enemies aren't knocked back, so check who you hit with Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don't engage alone.
Udyr.watch: Udyr's stun is ready just after he activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so don't engage him first. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, while Udyr W Iron Mantle helps him survive trades with its shield and healing. During the awakened state of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, immobilizing effects don't work, so look to knock him up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike after the awakening ends.

Vi.build: Vi's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Vi W Denting Blows shreds armor and deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone and consider ways to reduce Vi's attack speed.
Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Follow with basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack, knocking her up with the third basic attack. If she's far away, hit her first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Vi.escape: The moment after you bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
Vi.fight: Vi W Denting Blows becomes threatening when she keeps hitting the same target, so keep trades short. Close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge right after you dodge or bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker.
Vi.laning: If your gank target is far away, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Trade after Vi's shield has been removed, and check whether the enemy laners can rotate before counterjungling.
Vi.phase: In the mid game, farm camps and create skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don't engage alone. The available information isn't enough to determine who is stronger in each phase between Vi and Xin Zhao.
Vi.teamfight: If Vi gets on your allied carry, follow with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, then knock her away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard after the knock-up from Vi R Cease and Desist ends, clearing space in front of your carry. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity applies to champions outside spear range, so don't engage thinking it will also block damage and crowd control from Vi when she's close.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Q Vault Breaker, it deals more damage, so back away or sidestep it.

Viego.build: Build armor first to block physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King also deals damage based on current health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Viego.combo: If you can get on him right away, attack in this order: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → activate Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike → basic attack → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack. Against a distant Viego, hit him first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to extend the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, then follow up. If Viego is charging W Spectral Maw, look for a chance to interrupt it with the knock-up from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Viego.escape: The window after Viego W Spectral Maw is down is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Viego R Heartbreaker is available, he can use it to escape, so look especially for a chance before it comes back up. Don't engage after failing to dodge Viego W Spectral Maw just because you trust Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity.
Viego.fight: After Viego W Spectral Maw is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and knock him up with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Back off from skirmishes you can't win so Viego can't possess someone and heal after a takedown.
Viego.laning: If you see Viego E Harrowed Path on terrain, he may be camouflaged, so don't push the lane in that direction and go around the area. When ganking, if the target is far away or you have river vision, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. Also check whether the enemy laners can rotate to that position.
Viego.phase: In the mid game, farm camps and create skirmishes around objectives, and deny Viego takedowns to reduce his opportunities to possess someone. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends. The available information isn't enough to determine which champion is stronger in the mid-to-late game.
Viego.teamfight: Engage after Viego W Spectral Maw is down, then activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard once you're on him. If Viego gets on your allied carry, knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard, and push him away from the spot where an ally has fallen so he can't touch the wraith. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity applies only to champions outside spear range, so stay wary of attacks and crowd control from Viego when he's close.
Viego.watch: The longer Viego W Spectral Maw is charged, the longer its stun lasts. If you see him charging, dodge to the side, and if you can reach him, interrupt it with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. When your health is low, you can be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker, so don't overstay.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Also get armor against his basic attack physical damage. If healing makes the duel drag on, build resistances first, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Warwick.combo: If you're far away, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge at its increased range. If they're close, use this sequence: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge → basic attack with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike active → Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning → basic attack → third basic attack, knocking them up with the third basic attack. If you're surrounded after engaging, activate Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Warwick.escape: If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, he can still escape with R Infinite Duress, so don't rush in. Close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge after Warwick E Primal Howl's fear and R Infinite Duress are down, especially before R comes back up. Use that window to knock him up with Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and activate R Crescent Guard.
Warwick.fight: Don't dump burst damage into Warwick while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; fight again after the fear goes off. When Warwick R Infinite Duress is down, close in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and knock him up with the third empowered basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. Warwick heals more as his health gets lower, so don't force a finish just because he's at half health.
Warwick.laning: Check whether the enemy laners can rotate before pressuring camps. If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position, so give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.phase: In the mid game, use the window when Warwick R Infinite Duress is down, but account for Warwick's healing when looking for a chance to finish him. In the late game, avoid engaging alone because Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
Warwick.teamfight: Engage after Warwick E Primal Howl and R Infinite Duress are down. If Warwick gets on your allied carry, use the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to clear space in front of them. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity applies only to champions outside spear range, so don't try to tank Warwick when he's on top of you by relying on the immunity alone.
Warwick.watch: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and triggers fear, so back off and re-engage after the fear goes off. If you're hit by Warwick R Infinite Duress, you're suppressed and can act, so be careful about engaging while R is available. When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and increases Warwick's movement and attack speed.

Zac.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter healing from Zac P Cell Division. Zac Q, W, and E deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor, and don't stack health alone because of Zac W Unstable Matter.
Zac.combo: If you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging and can land your third basic attack, interrupt the charge with the knock-up or with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down is your chance to engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. In teamfights, engage after Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot's crowd control are down.
Zac.fight: When Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close the gap with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and fight.
Zac.laning: If your gank target is far away, hit them first with the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to mark them as Challenged, then close in with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you spot the enemy jungler farming camps on the opposite side, you can take camps, but first check whether the enemy laners can rotate.
Zac.phase: In the mid game, farm camps and create skirmishes around objectives, and check whether Zac P Cell Division's revive is available before a fight. In the late game, Xin Zhao becomes vulnerable after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, so don't engage alone.
Zac.teamfight: Immediately after Zac engages on your allied carry, knock him away with Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's damage immunity applies only to champions outside spear range, so don't try to tank Zac while he's on top of you by relying on the immunity alone.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt him with the third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Also watch out for the crowd control from Zac Q Stretching Strikes and the maximum-health-based damage from Zac W Unstable Matter when he's close.
